MDR: Merchant Discount Rate: fee the merchant pays per card/UPI payment (interchange + scheme + acquirer margin).
GST: Goods & Services Tax. 18% is charged on the MDR fee itself, and is usually claimable back as input tax credit.
ITC: Input Tax Credit: GST paid on purchases that can be set off against GST collected on sales.
PA: Payment Aggregator: RBI-regulated firm that collects customer payments for many merchants and settles to them.
PG: Payment Gateway: technology that carries payment data securely between merchant, bank and network.
VAN: Virtual Account Number: a sub-account under one real bank account; one per store lets the bank tag every credit by store.
ZBA: Zero-Balance Account sweep: end-of-day move of sub-account balances to a master account.
CIT: Cash-in-Transit: armoured logistics that collect store cash and deposit it at a bank.
EDC: Electronic Data Capture: the card swipe/tap terminal.
POS: Point of Sale: the billing system/terminal at the counter.
RRN: Retrieval Reference Number: 12-digit ID of a card/UPI transaction, used to match records across parties.
UTR: Unique Transaction Reference: bank reference of a NEFT/RTGS/IMPS credit.
UPI: Unified Payments Interface: instant bank-to-bank payments run by NPCI.
NPCI: National Payments Corporation of India: operates UPI and RuPay.
ISO 8583: Message standard used by card terminals and networks for authorisation.
camt.053: ISO 20022 bank-to-customer statement file; carries reference text used for auto-matching.
escrow: Account at a scheduled bank where an aggregator holds merchants' money until settlement.
T+1: Settlement one business day after the transaction.
FOFO: Franchise-Owned Franchise-Operated store; partner is paid net of margin and stock.
Recon: Reconciliation: matching internal sales records to settlement reports and bank credits.
suspense: Holding ledger for money received that cannot yet be matched to a sale.
GL: General Ledger: the company's master accounting book.
ERP: Enterprise Resource Planning: system of record for inventory, sales and accounts.
EBITDA: Earnings before interest, tax, depreciation and amortisation.
DRHP: Draft Red Herring Prospectus: IPO document filed with SEBI.
RHP: Red Herring Prospectus: near-final IPO document.
TPAP: Third-Party Application Provider: app (e.g. PhonePe) that offers UPI via partner banks.
chargeback: Dispute where the issuer pulls money back from the merchant.
interchange: Fee paid by acquirer to card issuer; the largest part of MDR.
acquirer: Bank that enables a merchant to accept cards and receives the settlement.
sweep: Automatic transfer of balances between accounts.
nodal: Another word for the escrow account used under RBI payment-aggregator rules.
Host-to-host: Direct system-to-system file/API link between company and bank.
